title: Scholia vetera in Aratum / Scholia to Aratus' Phaenomena / Схолии к «Явлениям» Арата
author: Anonymous (drawing on Eratosthenes, Hipparchus and Stoic sources)
edition: Martin 1974 (Teubner, in copyright). Maass, Commentariorum in Aratum reliquiae (1898), is PD.
ru_evidence: No entry on ancientrome.ru and nothing in the ru-wiki listings. No Russian translation found.
en_evidence: Cuypers' Hellenistic Bibliography, 'Aratus and Aratea', lists only Martin's edition and studies, with no translation of the scholia.
value: Ancient astronomy, constellation myths, meteorology and doxography (Mansfeld); a bridge to Eratosthenes' Catasterisms and the Latin Aratea. Appeals to historians of science and a wide readership.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Technical astronomy needs diagrams and expert review; otherwise straightforward explanatory prose.
pilot_unit: Scholia on Phaenomena 1–136 (proem, the Dike myth); est. ~12k words.
